title: Supply of Furniture items for the inspection quarters of Nagapattinam Lighthouse & DGNSS station under Chennai directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of teak wood cots, coir mattresses and a teak wood dressing table for the inspection quarters of Nagapattinam Lighthouse & DGNSS Station, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Nagapattinam Lighthouse & DGNSS Station, Marawady Street, Nagapattinam, Tamilnadu-611001
sites.work: Supply of furniture items for inspection quarters

scope.item: Supply of Teak Wood Single Cot, size 6¼' x 3', centre bedding portion plywood, inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight up to site
Supply of Coir Mattress for Single Cot, size 6¼' x 3' x 4", inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight up to site
Supply of Teak Wood Dressing table for bedroom with drawer, mirror, size 6.3' x 3.6', inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight up to site

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value as PBG/FDR, valid 60 days beyond warranty period; released after 1-year warranty
money.notes: Rates to be quoted inclusive of all taxes. Payment on final account basis after satisfactory supply; no extra payment beyond quoted rate.

period.completion: Supply within 10 days from date of supply order
period.warranty: 1 year against manufacturing defects for all wooden items

eligibility: At least one similar work of not less than Rs 98,400, or two of Rs 61,500 each, or three of Rs 49,200 each, during last seven years ending 31 March 2025
Similar work: supply of office furniture items in Central Govt./State Govt./public listed/PSUs
Non-blacklisting affidavit on firm's letter head for last 3 years
Valid registration and office address in Tamil Nadu / Puducherry (MSME certificate, business registration)
Detailed technical specifications of items per Annexure A
Completion certificates from clients (not below Manager/AEE/Administrative Officer) with purchase order / GeM CRAC
specs: Teak wood single cot 6.25' x 3' with plywood centre bedding
Teak wood dressing table 6.3' x 3.6' with drawer and mirror
Design of teak wood items as per photo images attached with NIQ; inspection of wood before polishing/varnishing
notes: Offline sealed quotation; submission by 30/03/2026 15:00, opening 30/03/2026 16:00. Pages 5-6 are reference photos (teak wood single cot with mattress; dressing table). No estimated cost or EMD printed. Notice signed by Deputy Director for Director.
